title: Grief-related guilt
content: Guilt is extremely common in grief, about things left unsaid, about feeling relief in some circumstances, about moments of normalcy or even happiness after the loss, or simply about 'moving forward.' None of this means you loved them any less; guilt often shows up precisely because the relationship mattered so much.

source_citation.section: S2c – UNDERSTANDING GRIEF, §3 Content Library, item 6
